description: This file defines the PsrStream class which adapts a Guzzle 5 Stream to a PSR-7 Stream interface, enabling interoperability between Guzzle and PSR-7 stream handling.

classes.name: PsrStream
classes.description: A class that adapts a Guzzle 5 Stream to a PSR-7 Stream, implementing the PSR-7 StreamInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PsrStream with a GuzzleStreamInterface instance.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Repositions the stream pointer to the beginning.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of the stream.
